source.title: Pricing V9 / SRM: Supplier price versioning, quantity tiers and costing integration
source.body:
## Business goal
Build a durable supplier purchase-price master for VNC apparel/OEM, printing, embroidery, trim, manufacturing and sourcing costs. The system must not treat generic in-code COST_LIBRARY defaults as confirmed supplier quotations.

## Current baseline (verified in main)
- Prisma CostingSourcePrice has supplier/source/unitPrice/unit/calculationType/isActive/note only; no purchase currency, qty tier, effective dates, quote document or history record.
- upsertCostingSourcePrice updates existing supplier+source row in place, destroying independent prior purchase-price revisions.
- product-costing-template selects reference price only when a single eligible source or default supplier; ambiguous supplier prices are warned and priced at 0.
- ServicePriceRule is a selling service rule, not an authoritative supplier buy-price tier.

## Required functional scope
1. Introduce immutable SupplierPriceQuote / SupplierPriceRevision + SupplierPriceTier (or equivalent) with supplier, source item/process, quotation reference, evidence attachment, currency, tax basis, purchase unit, conversion, qty min/max, unit price, minimum charge, setup fees, validity dates, lead-time, incoterm/ship point, status, author/approver.
2. Preserve CostingSourcePrice as read-compatible projection/cache during phased migration. Backfill existing records as UNSOURCED/LEGACY_DRAFT; never label backfilled values as approved quotes.
3. APIs for create revision, compare, approve/activate, supersede, deactivate, and retrieve quote history; updates must not mutate immutable approved revisions.
4. Qty-tier overlap validation within supplier+source+revision+unit+currency+effective scope, with concurrency safety; no negative costs, invalid units or NaN.
5. Costing selector must filter valid, approved sources by quantity/date/unit/currency and require manual supplier choice if ambiguous. Conversion / FX decisions explicit; no automatic cheapest selection.
6. Snapshot supplier-price revision ID, selected price tier, currency, fx, conversion, resulting unit cost into final costing. Issued customer quotes and orders remain unchanged when current supplier prices change.
7. UX in Sourcing/SRM: searchable supplier price library, import/export spreadsheet with preview, single/bulk editing draft, comparison table, warnings for expired/unverified pricing, source evidence.
8. Permission gates on price visibility and approval; audit log; no production records deleted.

## Test and release gates
- Migration dry run on correctly identified Neon target; backup/rollback playbook.
- Unit tests: tiers, validity overlap, different purchase units, FX, zero/negative, supplier inactive, duplicate revisions, retroactive edits.
- Integration: BOM -> supplier quote revision -> costing -> approved customer quote -> PO -> actual cost; historic quotation snapshot remains stable.
- Typecheck, lint, CI, review, staging QA before production deploy.

## Execution order
P0 schema and migration-safe version model -> P0 server service / validation -> P0 costing selector -> P1 SRM UI and batch import -> P1 PO and actual cost reconciliation.

Related PR #354 fixes a separate manual sell price calculation defect.
